query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_niche, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN notes LIKE '%plantes_niches%' OR notes LIKE '%Source:%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as imported_niche
FROM plants 
WHERE name IN ('Mimosa tenuiflora', 'Mimosa ophthalmocentra', 'Anadenanthera peregrina', 'Bursera graveolens', 'Vanilla planifolia', 'Silphium sp.', 'Dysphania ambrosioides');
